WorkDescription.description:
### Sprint Objective
Complete the integration of Stripe Customer Portal with direct sync to our billing schema.

### Core Tasks
1. Set up an Express endpoint `/api/billing/portal` mapping user tokens to Customer Portal sessions.
2. Handle `customer.subscription.updated` and `invoice.payment_succeeded` webhook operations with absolute consistency.
3. Implement proper client-side loading spinners and error screens.

### Expectations
Ensure all DB updates are wrapped in clean transactions. Write unit tests for the webhook handler. Submit a draft log listing endpoint responses, DB schemas modified, and test results.

### Sync Architecture Objective
Implement conflict resolution handlers on the WebSocket channel.

### Core Tasks
- Hook up a last-write-wins CRDT strategy for updating card states.
- Create a mock latency network testing suite inside `/test/network.ts`.
- Write proper logs showing concurrent resolution outputs.

### Requirements
Logs should explicitly show how conflicts are resolved when two users drag cards simultaneously.

Log.content: Completed task 1 and 2. I have added the backend routing in `server.js` matching client customer logins to Stripe portal URLs. Also added Supabase DB listeners for user plan mapping. Webhook signatures are validated using standard credentials. All webhook handlers run successfully. Added unit tests for payment success and billing updates. 100% of tests are passing.
Started conflict resolver setups. Created websocket client scripts. Resolved index errors.
